purpose: Bounded matched CPU/native-GPU functionality and conservation gate; no performance conclusion

mesh.generator: Existing same-pin CPU blockMesh, run once after protocol approval
mesh.matching: Copy the generated polyMesh into both backend cases and require byte-identical mesh hashes

controls.other_initial_boundary_and_transport_inp: Unchanged from the pinned template; identical hashes required

proposed_cross_backend_field_gates.velocity_max_definition: Maximum Euclidean norm of the cell velocity difference
proposed_cross_backend_field_gates.pressure_gauge: Compare directly with the same pRefCell0/pRefValue0; do not fit an offset after seeing results

native_GPU_execution_proof.method: Separate renamed icoFoamStrictV2 application copied from pristine pinned CPU icoFoam; add only one NVTX push/pop enclosing the entire first while-loop body including write/ExecutionTime. Vendor source and SDK remain unchanged. Compile only this application after native GPU libraries finish.
native_GPU_execution_proof.capture_prerequisite: Verify the named first-step NVTX range actually triggered capture; do not infer coverage from flags. Preserve existing LD_PRELOAD when adding an observer.
native_GPU_execution_proof.child_wrapper: Record actual direct solver child PID, binary SHA256 and return code atomically after wait; profiler/outer shell status is separate. Preserve inherited LD_PRELOAD.
native_GPU_execution_proof.required: At least one successful CUDA launch API in the complete first-step NVTX window; zero failed launches/synchronizations. Child continues remaining4 steps unprofiled and must exit0.
native_GPU_execution_proof.count_scope: API call counts are not distinct GPU kernel counts; no kernel timeline or speedup claim

preservation: Original stock cases, failed-screen status, logs, source, SDK, inputs and journals remain unchanged. No C29 run is included. Native original stock run and watcher must terminate normally/fail their original screen before the new native case starts.
binary_selection: Use the backend's absolute executable and private env; never resolve icoFoam through a global/default PATH. Keep controlDict.application identical.
